newsitem.title: UK: Ecuador embarks on roadshow for Eurobond next week.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador embarks on roadshow for Eurobond next week.

text.p: Ecuador will hold a series of investor presentations next week for its debut Eurobond issue, a syndicate official at Chase said.
Chase will lead manage the transaction.
"They will visit Geneva, London and Frankfurt next week, then a number of cities in the U.S.," the Chase official said.
The Ecuador team will visit London Wednesday, April 2.
No decision has yet been made on the launch date or terms and conditions of the bond.
In early February the mooted $300 million five-year offering was put on hold amid political uncertainty.
